build_CSPDarkNet_backbone: build a CSPDarkNet depth 53 backbone model for YOLOv4 object detection feature extraction
build_CSPResNet_backbone: build a CSPResNet depth 50 backbone model with configurable deep stem for image classification
build_CSPResNeXt_backbone: build a CSPResNeXt depth 50 backbone model with grouped convolutions for feature extraction
create_DarknetBottleneck_block: create a DarknetBottleneck block with 1x1 and 3x3 convolutions and optional residual identity skip connection
create_CSPStage_block: create a CSPStage block that splits features into two paths and concatenates after processing one path
